content:
{
  "phoneNote": "Well-structured editorial layout with strong typography, dark forest green accents, and clear hierarchy from top to bottom.",
  "desktopNote": "The hero text card sits too low on the image, pushing the supporting text and primary calls to action below the fold on an 800px screen, and the opening hours section leaves half the screen empty.",
  "phone": {
    "impression": 4,
    "hierarchy": 5,
    "imagery": 4,
    "spacing": 4,
    "clutter": 5,
    "distinctiveness": 4
  },
  "desktop": {
    "impression": 4,
    "hierarchy": 3,
    "imagery": 4,
    "spacing": 3,
    "clutter": 5,
    "distinctiveness": 4
  },
  "fixes": [
    "Pull the overlapping dark hero card higher up on desktop (or reduce the hero image height slightly) so the body copy and calls to action are visible in the first screen.",
    "Pair the 'Kdaj vas pričakujemo' opening hours with the address or a map on desktop so the right half of that band isn't left completely empty.",
    "Give the primary hero link ('Poglejte degustacije') a subtle button treatment or arrow icon so it stands out more clearly from the secondary 'Pot do nas' link."
  ],
  "blockers": []
}
